verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use original English-language book years rather than composition, translation, adaptation or Narnian internal-chronology dates. The Screwtape Letters ran in weekly Guardian installments in 1941 before its 1942 book edition. Lewis published poetry by 1919, outside the fiction-book bar. Later Narnia editions may number The Magician's Nephew first by story chronology even though The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe was published first in 1950. Publications after Lewis's death, including The Dark Tower and Other Stories (1977), are excluded.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
